reviewer: Assistant after viewing original, unchanged previously inspected approved style input, decoded export, light/dark/checkerboard panels, both usage sizes and all eight current container colors; independent pose/equipment/readability observation by second assistant reviewer

checks.name: identity
checks.observation: Viewed original and decoded runtime: one adult seated at a wide-grip lat pulldown station with overhead pulley, cable, bar, seat, thigh pad and weight stack. Entire figure and machine are contained.

checks.name: style-consistency
checks.observation: Compared with the actual approved front-plank master: blue-gray top, muted terracotta leggings, hair bun, natural proportions and soft educational shading remain consistent. Shoes and equipment are restrained neutral gray, with no visible branding.

checks.name: pose-and-contact-readability
checks.observation: Hands grip beyond shoulder width, elbows bend downward and the bar visibly crosses in front near the collarbone/upper chest rather than behind the neck. Hips rest on the seat, thigh pad crosses the lap, and complete lower legs/shoes read as plausibly planted. No obvious duplicated limb, missing hand or disconnected joint observed. Independent reviewer agreed these visual observations; no clinical exercise validation is claimed.

checks.name: equipment-continuity
checks.observation: Cable visibly connects the central bar attachment to the overhead pulley. Tall frame, guide/stack area, seat support and base read continuously, with no obvious disconnected cable end, extra machine or clipped equipment. This is observed visual continuity, not mechanical certification.

checks.name: alpha-and-decoded-edges
checks.observation: Viewed source/export light/dark composites, decoded checkerboard and all eight current container colors. Surroundings and frame openings are transparent, with no visible rectangular backdrop, colored fringe or distracting matte halo.

checks.name: usage-framing
checks.observation: Viewed actual source/export 256x144 and 320x180 panels and all eight current 320x180 composites. Seated pulldown identity and complete machine remain recognizable. Thin cable, connector and grip details become less explicit at small sizes, especially on dark surfaces; larger view carries those details. Top machine and lower shoes have roughly 3-4dp unclipped margins at 180dp height.

checks.name: interface-remnants
checks.observation: No visible text, weight numbers, arrows, labels, gym background, app controls, phone frame, logo or watermark observed.

limitations: Thin cable and fine grip/connector details lose clarity at small sizes on dark surfaces; provide the optional larger view for those details.
Visual pose/contact/equipment observations do not clinically validate exercise technique or mechanically certify the machine.
Untagged source pixels are explicitly interpreted as sRGB under the profile, without claiming measured embedded sRGB or a color conversion.

Usage boards are deterministic illustration composites using current presentation.json container colors, not actual RN/native component renders, text/control contrast measurements or signed-phone acceptance.
Human artwork and activation approval remain pending; no production promotion performed.
